The perspective distortion is subtle but present; the inner lens ellipse does not perfectly match the outer rim's perspective. The Topology Auditor's high confidence score (0.97) confirms the object is a single coherent mass, but it fails to detect the internal structural nonsense of the hinge, which the Router correctly flagged. The Geometric Depth Auditor found no grounding issues, which is consistent with the clean white background.
